hooks.command: command -v sdlc >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; in=$(cat); out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sdlc hook pre-tool) || out=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sdlc hook pre-tool) || { printf '%s\n' '[sdlc] The SDLC harness check could not run (sdlc hook pre-tool failed twice), so this call is blocked. Retry the call; if it keeps failing, run `sdlc doctor`.' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$out"
command -v sdlc >/dev/null 2>&1 && sdlc hook stop || true
